Dan Barry (reporter)

Dan Barry is a longtime reporter and columnist for The New York Times . He is the author of five books, including This Land: America, Lost and Found , a collection of his national columns for The Times that was published in 2018.

Bottom of the 33Rd

Hope and Redemption in Baseball's Longest Game

Description

On April 18, 1981, a minor-league game refused to end. Eight hours stretched through a Rhode Island night, suspending two teams and a shivering town between past and future, sorrow and joy. Dan Barry follows the whole cast caught in that extraordinary dusk: the batboys edging toward manhood, the ejected manager squinting through a hole in the backstop, the wives waiting at home, the umps and broadcasters and sunflower-spitting players. Two of them — Cal Ripken and Wade Boggs — were bound for Cooperstown.
